title: Word-Level Explanations for Analyzing Bias in Text-to-Image Models

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating word-influence scores (inspired by Shapley values) by replacing specific words in text prompts using a masked language model (BERT), generating images from the modified prompts using a text-to-image model (Stable Diffusion), and using an image classifier (CLIP) to measure changes in the male-to-female ratio of the generated subjects.
